title: Zesty Croatian Citrus Paella
description: A light and citrusy paella dish from Croatia, perfect for a weeknight dinner. It combines the warmth of yellow curry paste with the tanginess of ferment jang for a unique flavor experience.

ingredients.name: Citrus Zest (Lemon & Orange)
ingredients.notes: Use a zester to get the zest, don't press too hard to avoid bitterness.

ingredients.name: Shrimp
ingredients.notes: You can use any other seafood or omit if you prefer.

ingredients.name: Lemon Juice
ingredients.notes: You can use bottled or fresh lemon juice.

instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of vegetable oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2 minutes per side. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add the remaining 1 tbsp of vegetable oil, then the sliced ginger, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the yellow curry paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly, to prevent burning.
Add the ferment jang and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the white rice, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the water, lemon juice, and citrus zest. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
After 20 minutes, remove the cover and add the cooked shrimp back into the pan.
Return the pan to medium heat and cook for an additional 5 minutes, until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is cooked through.
